description: This file contains utility functions and regex patterns for classifying and normalizing source file paths within a project, particularly distinguishing code files from tests, fixtures, API barrels, and infrastructure artifacts.

methods.name: normalizeExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in the given file path for normalization.

methods.name: classifyBundledExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Classifies a normalized file path into categories such as code file, test, infrastructure, API barrel, or production source, based on regex pattern matching.
